title: Witness and Ledger
author: Jonah Okonkwo
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
